z1aqccr1c4.text: A design tool where you and your AI agent draw together.

g60emyu9bx.text: Open a canvas in your browser. Your agent, Claude Code or any other that speaks MCP, creates screens, components and diagrams on it while you watch, fix things by hand and undo anything.

6mjl30xgbb.text: Ask in plain words and watch it appear on the canvas.

1f1ca0tcus.text: Build a screen once, turn its parts into components and reuse them as instances.

60ybniktc2.text: Boxes, decisions, sticky notes and arrows that follow the shapes when you move them.

aybc0ljvyn.text: Design tokens switch a whole design between themes in one go.

bi9wgnbwy0.text: Export any frame as HTML, a React component or SVG.

jp6av6l734.text: You and the agent share one history, so nothing either of you did is lost.

yehd9b29j0.text: Press I, click a spot and leave a note. The agent picks it up and answers there.

2o3lm0xt2g.text: Before it tells you it is done, the agent takes a screenshot and runs the same checks a careful designer would.
